name: OpenAI Codex

surfaces.name: Codex CLI, IDE extension and app: skill folder
Codex plugin from a local marketplace
steps: This builds ~/design-dna/hosts/codex-marketplace and, when codex is on PATH, runs: codex plugin marketplace add <that folder>, then codex plugin add design-dna@design-dna-local

prerequisites: Codex CLI, IDE extension or app, signed in
Python 3.10+ and Chromium for the engine (python install.py doctor)

docs.title: Agent Skills (Codex)
docs.facts: Skill locations: $CWD/.agents/skills, parents up to $REPO_ROOT/.agents/skills, $HOME/.agents/skills, /etc/codex/skills, bundled system skills. Optional agents/openai.yaml sets interface fields and policy such as allow_implicit_invocation.

docs.title: Package your plugin
docs.facts: A plugin folder has .codex-plugin/plugin.json and skills/<name>/SKILL.md. Marketplaces live at $REPO_ROOT/.agents/plugins/marketplace.json or ~/.agents/plugins/marketplace.json; source.path is ./-prefixed and relative to the marketplace root. codex plugin marketplace add takes owner/repo, Git URLs or local paths.

docs.title: openai/plugins (official examples)
docs.facts: .codex-plugin/plugin.json declares "skills": "./skills/" and an interface block; .agents/plugins/marketplace.json lists plugins with source {source: local, path} and a policy.

docs.title: Use Agent Skills in VS Code
